Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description: At Jellyfish we believe that our individual differences are our greatest assets. We are passionate about empowering every employee to reach their full potential and contribute their unique perspectives to our collaborative environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and firmly believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce drives innovation and leads to better solutions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other personal characteristics that make them who they are. Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand. LOCATION: Mexico City Job Description As a Data Scientist within Jellyfish’s Cloud and Martech practice, you will help design and deliver advanced measurement, modelling, and predictive analytics solutions that improve client performance and inform strategic decision-making. You will work across multiple teams to transform complex data into clear insights, build scalable analytical frameworks, and apply modern data science techniques to real marketing and customer experience challenges. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys statistical problem-solving, collaborative project work, and building analytical products that directly influence media efficiency and business outcomes. Responsibilities Analyse large and complex datasets to uncover trends, diagnose performance issues, and generate actionable recommendations. Apply and explain data science methodologies such as Geo-based experiments, Media Mix Models, Causal Impact Studies, Incrementality testing, and other robust statistical approaches. Develop and implement predictive and causal models that improve media performance, customer experiences, and revenue outcomes. Work with internal partners and external platforms to advance our capabilities in incrementality testing, media modelling, and privacy-safe measurement techniques. Build reproducible analytical workflows, document processes clearly, and create repeatable frameworks that scale across clients and markets. Translate model outputs into compelling narratives through visualizations, dashboards, and structured readouts. Collaborate closely with Cloud Engineers, Analysts, and Martech specialists to ensure solutions integrate effectively into client ecosystems. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a quantitative discipline. Strong proficiency in Python and SQL. Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, Matplotlib, or similar. Understanding of the digital marketing ecosystem, including paid media channels, web/app analytics, and measurement frameworks. Experience working with datasets from tools such as Google Analytics, Campaign Manager, Amazon Marketing Cloud, ADH, Meta, or equivalents. Familiarity with MMM, incrementality testing, attribution models, or causal inference techniques. Curiosity and initiative, you look for ways to improve, automate, and scale analytical work. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex methods to non-technical stakeholders. Exposure to machine learning concepts (hands-on experience is a plus). Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English. Additional Information Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs. 💰 Savings fund: You'll save 5% of your monthly income and Jellyfish will contribute the same amount you save to your savings fund. 💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours. 📈 Growth, Your Way: Accumulate one paid day each month (2 hours per week) for self-development and access to Jellyfish Learn. 🏥 Health Insurance: We provide a private health insurance policy that includes visual and dental plan coverage. Title: Senior Data Scientist Consultant

Provenir helps fintechs, financial institutions, and payment providers make smarter decisions, faster. We are passionate about technology and empowering businesses to become industry leaders. If you’d like to work at an innovative fintech with a global footprint that is redefining the industry, then we want you! We deploy data science, applied AI, and delivery expertise directly into client engagements, operating as trusted advisors and technical partners, not back-office implementers. GAI operates through regional business partnerships supported by global practices, meaning the right expertise reaches every engagement regardless of geography. What You’ll Do This is a commercially significant hire. You will be the Data Science business partner for the Ibero-America region, working directly with clients to shape and deliver high-impact solutions in fraud, credit risk, and collections. You will also contribute to EMEA engagements where your expertise is the right fit. This is not a back-room modelling role. You will be in front of clients, understanding their business challenges, designing solutions that create measurable value, and communicating that value clearly to senior stakeholders. You will also support the commercial pipeline, partnering with Sales and Solutions Consulting to shape opportunities and win new business. Reporting to the Head of Data Science within GAI, you will have the backing of a strong global practice and the platform to build a reputation in one of our most strategically important regions. This is a remote role, but you must be based in Mexico City, Mexico . Occasional travel may be required for regional team meet-ups and client meetings. Your Responsibilities 🚀 Client Delivery & Consultancy Engage directly with clients, including at senior and C-suite level, to diagnose business challenges and design data science solutions with clear, quantified business value. Lead delivery of fraud, credit risk, and collections analytics projects from scoping through implementation, on time and within scope. Communicate technical solutions and outcomes to non-technical audiences, including senior client stakeholders and executive sponsors. Commercial Support Partner with Sales and Solutions Consulting during the commercial cycle, shaping proposals, contributing to statements of work, and providing technical credibility in client conversations. Help identify and qualify data science opportunities across the region, including proactively surfacing expansion opportunities within existing accounts. Technical Execution Identify, source, and prepare data to enable the development, calibration, and deployment of state-of-the-art AI/ML models across the credit lifecycle. Stay current on emerging data science trends and techniques; propose high-leverage innovations that strengthen Provenir's competitive position. Contribute to analytical strategy and product development with expert input grounded in real client experience. Team Leadership & Standards Mentor and coach Data Scientists within the region, raising standards of technical delivery and client consultancy. Operate effectively in ambiguity, pivoting fluidly between hands-on problem solving and high-level roadmapping as business needs demand. Your Strengths And Skills 🛠️ 7+ years in a data science role, with hands-on expertise in supervised and unsupervised ML methods. Domain expertise in at least one of: fraud detection, credit risk management, or collections analytics. Demonstrated B2B client-facing experience, confident engaging senior stakeholders on ML products and their business value. Strong commercial instinct: ability to frame, estimate, and communicate ROI on data science initiatives. Strong data wrangling skills: merging, cleansing, sampling, and preparing complex datasets. Exceptional communication skills and the ability to build trust across technical and non-technical audiences. Fluent in Spanish and English. Although not essential, it would be great if you also have any of these strengths: Experience drafting project proposals and statements of work. Demonstrated track record of leading data science projects and raising standards of those around you. MLOps best practices: CI/CD, pipeline orchestration, model monitoring. Industry experience in auto finance or telco financial services. Portuguese language skills (Brazilian or European). Interview Process 💬 We Run a Straightforward Four-stage Process Recruiter Screen - understanding your background, motivations, and any questions you have about the role. Technical Challenge - a take-home task representative of the problems you will work on. Technical Interview - deep-dive with Data Science colleagues. Commercial Interview - business and behavioral conversation with senior GAI leadership. Our employees are our top priority; we offer comprehensive health and wellness plans. You will enjoy paid time off and company holidays, flexible and remote-friendly opportunities, and maternity/paternity leave. At Provenir, we recognize that diversity and inclusion make our teams stronger. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, domestic partner status, citizenship, or veteran status or medical condition. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

Title: Senior Web Analyst – Adobe Analytics & Journey Analytics
Description: Company Description Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape. Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. Job Description Sandisk is seeking a Senior Web Analyst to serve as the primary expert for Adobe Analytics across sandisk.com. This role is responsible for ensuring our digital measurement is intentional, well-documented, and genuinely useful. In addition to AA, Sandisk is expanding its analytics capabilities with Amplitude Growth Analytics to better understand user journeys, engagement patterns, and behavioral drivers across sandisk.com. This role will help define how Adobe Analytics and Amplitude work together, ensuring each tool is used intentionally for the questions it answers best. You will be the connective tissue between data, technology, and decision-making. While the web strategy team has content strategists, UX designers, and dedicated SEO and technical audit partners, this role provides the deep analytics expertise those teams rely on to understand engagement , performance , customer journeys , and business impact . You will shape how data is collected, structured, interpreted, and self-served across the web, e-commerce, and performance marketing organization. This is an individual contributor role for someone who takes pride in high-quality instrumentation, loves clickstream analysis, and understands how thoughtful measurement unlocks better experiences and better business outcomes. This is an in‑house role focused on long‑term analytics quality and business enablement rather than client delivery. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Adobe Analytics Ownership & Enablement Act as the primary Adobe Analytics expert for sandisk.com, owning Analysis Workspace structure, variable strategy, and data usability. Design, build, and maintain scalable dashboards and workspace projects, from executive summaries to deep-dive exploratory analyses. Establish and document a clear, consistent variable taxonomy that enables reliable self-service reporting. Serve as a role model and enablement partner for a small group of internal Analytics power users. Design and maintain standardized Adobe Analytics Workspace templates that serve as trusted, reusable sources of truth for common business questions. Measurement Strategy & Implementation Own the quality and evolution of both the Adobe Analytics and Amplitude Growth Analytics implementations. Partner with IT and development teams to write detailed measurement requirements. Influence tagging strategy within Adobe Launch. Ensure analytics implementations reflect strong understanding of browser behavior and tagging mechanics. Clickstream & Customer Journey Analysis Conduct advanced clickstream, pathing, and flow analysis. Analyze end-to-end digital customer journeys. Demonstrate how the website delivers business value beyond last-click conversion. Journey & Behavioral Analytics (Amplitude) Partner with Web Strategy, UX, and eCommerce stakeholders to use Amplitude Growth Analytics for journey analysis, behavioral segmentation, and hypothesis-driven exploration. Help define event, property, and user schema in Amplitude in coordination with Adobe Analytics variable strategy. Translate business questions into Amplitude analyses such as funnels, paths, cohorts, and retention views. Ensure consistency and alignment between Adobe Analytics and Amplitude data definitions, metrics, and narratives. Contribute to documentation and enablement so teams understand when to use Adobe Analytics vs. Amplitude. Use Amplitude to answer journey, engagement, and behavioral questions, not to duplicate standard Adobe Analytics reporting. Communication & Influence Act as the senior analytics subject‑matter expert for sandisk.com, setting standards and guiding analytical decision‑making. Serve as a thought partner on analytics platform strategy, helping Sandisk evolve from page-level reporting toward journey and behavior-led decision-making. Communicate insights and recommendations clearly in English to US‑based and global stakeholders. Partner with Web Strategy, SEO, UX, Content, and Product teams. Advocate for meaningful, high-quality measurement. Success in This Role Looks Like A cleaner, more intentional Adobe Analytics implementation. High confidence in reported data across teams. Actionable journey insights that influence UX, content, or conversion optimization decisions. Self-service reporting enabled through Workspace templates. Clear demonstration of website business value. Trusted partnership with Web Strategy, UX, and Engineering teams in a cross‑functional, multinational environment. Qualifications REQUIRED: 8+ years of experience in digital or web analytics roles. Deep expertise with Adobe Analytics and Analysis Workspace. Strong working knowledge of Adobe Launch or similar tag management system. Experience writing analytics requirements for IT teams. Understanding of browser-based tracking and tag management. Experience with clickstream and behavioral data analysis. Familiarity with Google Search Console. Excellent communication skills. Professional fluency in spoken and writtenEnglish, with experience presenting insights to US‑based stakeholders. Preferred Experience with enterprise or global ecommerce websites. Experience working with multiple analytics platforms in defined roles. Experience with product or journey analytics tools such as Amplitude. Experience enabling analytics self‑service. Strong documentation discipline. Additional Information Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. Analizar tendencias, correlaciones y causas raíz relacionadas con: Rotación Headcount Ausentismo Desempeño Productividad Reclutamiento Clima Organizacional Calidad de contratación Desarrollo del talento Traducir información compleja en insights accionables para la toma de decisiones. Detectar riesgos y oportunidades mediante modelos analíticos. Acompañar a líderes de Recursos Humanos en la interpretación de indicadores. Promover una cultura de decisiones basadas en datos. Garantizar el manejo ético y confidencial de la información de Capital Humano. Perfil que buscamos Buscamos un perfil muy específico. No buscamos un Data Analyst tradicional. Buscamos un verdadero People Analytics Specialist , es decir, un profesional que haya desarrollado su experiencia dentro del área de Recursos Humanos utilizando analítica como herramienta para la toma de decisiones. Debe entender profundamente los procesos de Recursos Humanos y, al mismo tiempo, contar con sólidas capacidades analíticas. Requisitos indispensables Formación Académica Licenciatura concluida en: Actuaría Matemáticas Administración Ingeniería Industrial Ingeniería en Sistemas Ciencia de Datos Tecnologías de Información Economía Carreras afines Deseable: Certificación en Data Analytics. Business Intelligence. Data Visualization. People Analytics. Experiencia Entre 4 y 6 años de experiencia profesional. Experiencia desarrollando funciones de People Analytics o HR Analytics . Experiencia previa trabajando directamente dentro de áreas de Recursos Humanos. Experiencia construyendo modelos de información para Capital Humano. Experiencia desarrollando dashboards ejecutivos. Experiencia definiendo KPIs de Recursos Humanos. Experiencia generando análisis para apoyar decisiones estratégicas. Experiencia colaborando con todas las subáreas de Recursos Humanos (Atracción de Talento, Desarrollo Organizacional, Compensaciones, Capacitación, Cultura, etc.). Conocimientos Técnicos People Analytics. HR Analytics. Workforce Analytics. Business Intelligence. Modelado de datos. Excel Avanzado. Google Sheets. Power BI. Tableau. Data Visualization. Dashboards Ejecutivos. KPIs de Recursos Humanos. Estadística aplicada. Gobierno de datos. Calidad de datos. Procesos de Recursos Humanos. Manejo confidencial de información. Business Intelligence Analyst que nunca haya trabajado con procesos de Capital Humano. Científicos de Datos sin conocimiento funcional de Recursos Humanos. Gerentes de Recursos Humanos sin experiencia desarrollando People Analytics. Consultores que únicamente hayan participado de forma externa y no busquen integrarse de manera permanente a un equipo. Proactividad. Orientación a resultados. Mejora continua. Adaptabilidad. Trabajo colaborativo. Inteligencia emocional. Será fundamental que sea una persona altamente autoadministrable , acostumbrada a trabajar bajo esquemas híbridos y con un alto nivel de autonomía, gestionando prioridades sin necesidad de supervisión constante. Title: Data Analyst
Industries: Software Development, Financial Services, and Technology, Information and Internet
Description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About The Team As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grow dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs of external users and internal Stripe teams. At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together. We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals. What you’ll do As an analyst on the Payments Health Operations team, you will be charged with monitoring and maintaining payments performance for Stripe’s largest users. This will include triaging, investigating, and responding to detected regressions in authentication and cost rates; providing in-depth analysis of performance degradations; answering queries from our product support and technical account management teams; and engaging with users and other teams at Stripe to help ensure our users are maximizing their acceptance rates while minimizing their costs and fraud. You will work at the core of Stripe's platform, ensuring the reliability of our payments stack and the health of the broader ecosystem. Technical Operations roles in Payments are a dynamic and key component of Stripe's success. Focused on financial partner integrations and funds-flow expansion, we sit at the intersection of product/platform engineers and financial partners, connecting them to ensure that everyone thrives and nothing is lost in translation. Responsibilities Monitor authorization rates and performance for large users, responding to alerts of degradation, triaging and investigating the cause, and communicating your findings to the account team, banking partners, and card networks. Analyze cost checkers to ensure our cost models' accuracy. Respond to performance inquiries from technical account managers, product support teams, and other internal Stripe teams. Interface with Stripe’s financial partners across the world to communicate operational breakages and help drive resolutions. Provide fast, accurate responses to complex support inquiries from partners. Partner with internal and external teams to validate the accuracy of Stripe’s financial data. Introduce data and process efficiencies to meet the scale and speed of Stripe. Identify and automate inefficient operational processes to reduce manual workloads. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum Requirements Have at least 1 year of experience in a technical role, with experience writing SQL queries to query relational databases. Have experience navigating the nuanced complexity of financial systems and solving large-scale, technical challenges. Have strong analytical skills to investigate, prioritize, and identify the root cause of issues. Have experience managing communications and workflows with technical and non-technical teams across internal and external stakeholders. Are comfortable operating independently and thrive in a fast-paced environment to deliver results, with an ability to establish priorities and reliably execute against time-sensitive deadlines. Have experience identifying and triaging technical issues. Possess a demonstrated track record of process improvement and proactive problem-solving. Have excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish. Preferred Qualifications Payments expertise (working with financial partners, optimizing processing errors, managing payment costs). Experience operating in a high-growth technology company. Python or Scala knowledge. In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

Title: Business Intelligence Senior Analyst

They will also guide, advise, and enable stakeholders to effectively use our BI tools, to translate data into meaningful insights for teams and leaders to confidently take action on. The ideal candidate will be passionate about all things data, dashboards, and visualizations. Strong communications skills with the ability to influence various levels of leaders using data and logic Aptitude and drive to learn new technologies, frameworks, and analysis techniques (e.g. AI, Semantics, conversational BI, Generative BI) Is comfortable taking ownership for the design & implementation of technical solutions Strong team player; able to work effectively within a team and more broadly with people from a variety of backgrounds, locations, and functional areas. Title: CX & AI Enablement Sr Analyst
Description: About The Company DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services. DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future. For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news About The Team/role DiDi's Service Operations team makes customer experience work across different countries — every day, across multiple business lines and BPO partners operating in very different market realities. This role sits inside that team. You will work directly with the AI Enablement Manager on initiatives that span data, quality, and AI — in production, not in proof-of-concept mode. The work is real and the scope is wide. You will touch markets with different languages, different regulations, and different operational rhythms. Your output will be used by teams in São Paulo, Bogotá, Mexico City, Cairo, and beyond. If you want to understand what it actually takes to deploy AI inside a complex, multi-country CX operation — this is where that happens. Not in a deck. In production. In this role, you'll be... Building and maintaining AI-powered systems that turn customer interaction data into actionable business intelligence — across multiple markets simultaneously. Writing and owning SQL queries independently — joins, aggregations, window functions, time filters — using platforms like Hive or BigQuery to extract and validate operational data at scale. Conducting discovery sessions with internal stakeholders across Brazil, Colombia, Mexico, Egypt, and China to translate operational problems into structured requirements that someone else can execute without you in the room. Replicating and adapting validated analytical and AI projects across new markets and business lines — without starting from scratch every time. Measuring the impact of everything you build. Not just shipping — tracking and documenting outcomes so the team knows what worked and why. Contributing to a shared knowledge infrastructure: templates, frameworks, and agent libraries that make the entire team more capable over time, not just you. We're eager to be in touch because you have... You write SQL the way other people write emails — independently, precisely, and without needing someone to validate your logic. Joins, aggregations, window functions, time filters. You've worked in Hive, BigQuery, or something equivalent, and when the results don't make sense, you know how to find out why. You've done real discovery. Not desk research — actual conversations with stakeholders where you asked the right questions, found something unexpected, and turned it into a requirements document that someone else could execute without you in the room. If you've never been surprised during a discovery session, this isn't the role. You think in outcomes, not deliverables. When you build something, you already know how you will measure whether it worked. You don't just ship — you track. You move forward in ambiguity. You ask sharp questions, produce a clear structure, and don't wait for perfect information to start. Your English is fluent enough to read technical documentation, write specs, and communicate results to stakeholders in Mexico City, Cairo, or Shanghai. BONUS — not required, but it tells us something important about you: You've built or experimented with AI agents (Claude Code, Dify, or similar). You know what recontact rate, CSAT, and AHT mean — and why they matter. You use BI tools (Looker, Metabase, Power BI) to communicate, not just to analyze. You know how to read code in JavaScript and Python well enough to correct code written by AI. You'll love working at DiDi because... Title: Data & Analytics Product Owner - Operations Excellence

You will work at the intersection of business and technology , partnering with global and regional teams to design data-driven solutions that enhance decision-making and drive operational performance. Title: Senior Consumer Insights Manager - Americas (m/f/d)

Description: Allow us to introduce ourselves Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions. You will act as a true sparring partner, exciting clients about customer centricity, agile market research, and innovative methods. You will play a critical role in effectively communicating insights, with a strong focus on engaging storytelling. Additionally, you will create, interpret, and present both high-level and in-depth reports in collaboration with cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment with client expectations and needs. create in-depth reports when needed (including charting, design, and insights) Present insights with a strong focus on storytelling, actionability, and clear recommendations Collaborate closely with the Sales team on the project scoping for new customers Manage projects and contribute to the strategic development of the Research Consulting Team and Appinio products Integrate AI across all research steps, collaborating with the Product team to enhance AI capabilities You will thrive in this role if You have more than 6 years of experience in end-to-end market research and consulting B2B clients, with strong knowledge of quantitative methods and statistics You have experience designing studies, writing questionnaires, and working across various research methods and use cases You have experience creating reports (in PowerPoint or G-Slides) based on market research data and are skilled in generating actionable insights, presenting them through clear storytelling to client-side stakeholders across different departments and seniority levels You bring a strategic and commercially minded approach, translating insights into business impact for clients You are fluent in English and proficient in Spanish (C2 level, spoken and written) You enjoy working hands-on with tools and platforms, including survey programming and process optimization, combining strategic thinking with practical execution You are proactive, curious, and driven to go the extra mile to deliver high-quality outcomes, while balancing excellence and efficiency You have excellent communication skills, a pragmatic mindset, and a strong affinity for data You have a cooperative and caring attitude What’s in it for you? We are looking for a Senior Executive BI who will: As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. Define QA guidelines and automate the current QA process, and—with support from the Assoc. Director—develop tools, processes, and best practices to achieve workflow efficiencies and drive value for client teams and clients. Act as the subject matter expert for questions/projects relating to data quality, BI tools, and business rules, ensuring that best practices are being followed amongst all projects. Experience in media (digital investment, analytics, or ad operations) and understanding of processes across multiple media channels (digital, search, social, offline, etc.), handling diverse datasets (paid media, owned, etc.). Advanced knowledge of databases and data warehouses such as SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redshift, Snowflake, etc., and one or more programming languages (e.g., Python). Knowledge of cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, GCP, AWS) and data engineering platforms (e.g., Databricks). Familiarity with business intelligence tools (Tableau, PowerBI) and project/product management tools (Jira, Confluence, Smartsheets, Azure DevOps/VSTS).
